prompt:
Image 1 is the exact character: a chibi young boy swordsman with messy light-brown hair with an ahoge, brown eyes, a long tattered olive-green scarf and cape, a steel shoulder guard, a quilted brown leather jerkin, leather bracers, brown trousers and boots, holding a plain steel sword in his right hand. Keep his identity, face, costume, colours, proportions, line style and the exact sword design from Image 1, at the same size and camera distance as Image 1, three-quarter view facing screen-right like Image 1. Do NOT mirror him: the sword stays in the same hand as in Image 1 (both hands on the hilt only where the pose says so), and the sword is always ONE whole rigid blade.

Draw ONE single full-body sprite of him rising out of the lunge into a controlled low guard, the sword held low beside his hip, calm and focused (not smiling), ready to hop back. A clear, readable, powerful silhouette for a small phone screen; the body commits to the action (feet, hips and shoulders), not only the arm. Eyes open.

Background: 100% solid flat magenta #FF00FF, no gradient, no floor, no shadow. Centered, the whole character and the whole sword fully inside the image with a wide magenta margin on all four sides. Clean anime game sprite, crisp lines, same rendering as Image 1. No motion blur, slash trail, glow, wind, sparks, particles, speed lines, text or labels.

precheck.summary: Solid flat magenta background, with the whole character and sword inside the frame and no cut-off. The character's hair, green cape, shoulder guard, jerkin and sword match the reference, the sword is one rigid blade in the same hand, and there is no visible text, extra figures or anatomy errors. The only drift is that the sprite is larger in frame than the reference, which is a minor layout difference rather than a defect.
